body: Orchestrator observation (2026-11-16, space-sprint-1 cdaa7c6): while three other vitest jobs ran on this Windows machine, Git-heavy tests timed out at 15 s, a different set each run — src/core/services/incrementVerify.test.ts, attemptsIncrement.test.ts, src/integration/incrementMerged.test.ts, multiRepo.test.ts (plus git.test.ts seen by DM-270). None of these files or src/core/services/incrementVerify.ts / src/core/repo/git.ts changed since main fd857e3, and they passed in a quiet run on 693d5fe. Timeouts are failures: run the sweep with nothing else running, and if any still exceeds its timeout, find the slow git spawns (Windows process creation) and fix the cause — never raise a timeout or rerun to green.
